Decide firstSix reply-style and process rules (about 250 words per chat) have no scenario behind them. I kept them as your standing preference; say so if you want them tested by removal.

Helpers start without AGENTS.md, so their prompts hold the safety rules and the return format. Skill and agent descriptions, also loaded per chat, went from 479 to 452 words.

Databases, Hard stops, Secrets and guard.mjs are unchanged. The generated guard command and deny rules are byte-identical to the baseline.

The context.md rule is scoped now, not enforced by a hook

Before
  • "After a change: update context.md"
  • a 1-line fix changes no state, so the agent skipped it and said so
After
  • replace stale lines when a task starts, finishes or blocks
  • never list it as left to do
  • no new hook code

challenger picked the same option before reading the choice, and objected that only the skip case was proven. That led to S11 (step 1 done, step 2 blocked), where the agent rewrote context.md with both.

Evidence
  • Plan and inventory (one row per AGENTS.md rule and per file, with the test or scenario behind it and the reason it stays): 2026-11-16-setup-refactor.md.
  • Checks after the change: node _ai/sync.mjs --check prints in sync; node --test "_ai/**/*.test.mjs" gives tests 19, pass 19, fail 0 (18 before; 1 new test for the language reminder); kiro-cli agent validate exits 0 on all 6 generated agent files.
  • Code review: reviewer on _ai/sync.mjs and _ai/sync.test.mjs returned ready, 0 Must fix, 0 Should fix.
  • Scenarios: claude -p "<prompt>" --output-format stream-json --verbose in fresh copies under the session scratchpad, each with the sample project Shop (paging off-by-one, SQL built from text, 2 shortcut: comments, a fake .env, a personal/ folder). Runs: 10 baseline, 4 on a candidate copy (S1, S2, S3, S9), 11 after, 1 repeat of S5. Total cost about 3.4 USD.
  • S5 after, first run: the first line said "2 with no trigger", then the reply corrected itself to 1; the repeat run was clean. The debt text of the skill did not change.
  • S3 after: the test failed first (page 2 returned [3,4,5]), then 3 of 3 pass; context.md and memory.md were named as not updated because they are blank templates, not as left to do.
  • Words: wc -w; chat = AGENTS.md + CLAUDE.local.md; helper start = _core.md + the agent file. _ai/ in total: 32,905 → 32,481 words, 78 → 77 files.
  • Per skill, before → after: delegate 542 → 503, plan 363 → 336, review 592 → 602 (it took the bug method), handoff 231 → 231, data/SKILL.md 1,213 → 1,204, confluence-project 573 → 573.
